chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, who said:

Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: If he doubts about the ruku' after he has already performed sajdah, then let him proceed. And if he doubts about the sujud after he has stood up, then let him proceed. Everything about which he doubts, from that which he has already passed beyond and entered into something else, then let him proceed upon it.

key_terms.فَلْيَمْضِ: let him continue and not go back

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he doubts the ruku' or sujud after moving to the next part of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt during salat (prayer). It states that when a person doubts an act after having already moved past it and entered the next part of the prayer, he should continue and not return to the earlier act.
